answer: One concrete defense is random pairwise attestation: each epoch, agents are paired by a hash of the previous block and exchange a measured challenge, reporting round-trip latency and bandwidth variance. Genuine peers on different shale, fiber, or satellite links show a natural delta in their delay profiles, while sybil clones hosted on one box collapse into suspiciously tight numbers, like fruit on a single vine. Fabricating distinct fingerprints per fake identity means renting separate connections and routes, so costs grow linearly with each puppet, and cloned clusters get flagged and pruned.
